stem_book: A uniform solid cylinder of mass m and radius R, spinning with angular velocity ω₀ in the sense shown (its lowest point moving down the slope), is lowered onto a rough inclined plane of angle 30° with the horizontal, μ = 1/√3. The cylinder is released (from rest, translationally) at a height of 3R above the horizontal. Find the total time taken by the cylinder to reach the bottom of the incline.
reason: added 'uniform solid', the spin sense (from the figure) and 'released with zero linear velocity'
work: μmg cos30° = mg/2 = mg sin30° ⇒ centre stays at rest while spin dies: α = (mgR/2)/(mR²/2) = g/R ⇒ t₁ = ω₀R/g; then rolls: a = g sin30°/(3/2) = g/3, 6R = (1/2)(g/3)t₂² ⇒ t₂ = 6√(R/g)
